read.en: Broadcom rose 5.5% on Nov 12 to $364.36, trading $354.72–369.82 on heavy volume (1.67x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($331.0), 10-day ($325.2) and 30-day ($339.8) and just below the 100-day ($365.1) and 200-day ($367.3); the 5-day and 200-day are rising. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 11, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($291.11), and RSI is 59.5.
read.zh: 博通 11月12日上涨 5.5%，收于 $364.36，盘中区间 $354.72–369.82，成交量放大（20 日均量的 1.67 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$331.0）、10 日（$325.2）和 30 日均线（$339.8）上方，略低于 100 日（$365.1）和 200 日均线（$367.3）；5 日和 200 日均线在上行。MACD 于 11月11日上穿信号线，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$291.11），RSI 为 59.5。

read.en: The rally cleared the $350.1–356.9 band (Oct 28 and Nov 11 highs), now support; the $369.82 high poked above the 100 and 200-day, but the close stayed under. Resistance is $365.1–369.8, then $376.6 (Aug 28 high) and $380.8 (Oct 6 high). Support is $350.1–356.9, then $339.8–345.2 (30-day, Nov 11 low) and $331–334.7. A close above $369.8 would target $376.6–380.8; below $350, $340–345.

s.en: Nov 11 high $356.85, cleared; Nov 12 low $354.72; Oct 28 high $352.4; Aug 26 low $350.06
